notes: v2.1.0 confirms the shared dome radius and anisotropic scale but does not currently include the 12 cassette panel objects.
v2.0.27 contains the experimental 12-sector shell-panel geometry. This layout retains that parent-sector logic and subdivides each large petal into smaller candidate modules.
The old model offsets the cassette surface slightly outside the dome skin to avoid visual z-fighting. This is a rendering offset, not a physical cavity or clearance requirement.

identification.sectorNumbering: 1-based, clockwise when viewed from above; exact north/origin orientation remains TBD
identification.columnNumbering: 1-based within parent sector; local azimuth origin remains TBD

engineeringNotes: All generated sizes and areas are in model units and model-unit squared; do not interpret them as metres or square metres.
Panel segmentation is a geometric proposal only. Fabrication width, mass, lifting, wind resistance, support spacing and serviceability are not verified.
The 12 parent sectors are addressing / maintenance zones. The 144 child panels are candidates for further rationalization, not an approved bill of materials.
No panel may be released from its support until an engineered service cradle and independent secondary retention are physically engaged.
